title: Senior Project Quality & Compliance Manager –EV
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai / Gurgaon / Bangalore
 



**Experience:** 
 10–15 Years
 



**Function:** 
 Project Quality / QA\-QC / PMC
 



**Industry:** 
 Commercial Interiors / Large\-Scale Fit\-Out
 



  




 About Flipspaces
 
 Flipspaces is a
 **design\-tech powerhouse** 
 transforming the way commercial spaces are designed and executed. Combining technology, design, manufacturing, and end\-to\-end project execution, we deliver large\-scale commercial interiors for leading enterprises, startups, co\-working operators, and global brands.
 



 As we scale our
 **Enterprise Verticals** 
 business, we are strengthening our quality and compliance framework across large, multi\-trade commercial interior projects.
 



  




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Project Quality \& Compliance Manager** 
 who will own quality assurance, material compliance, execution standards, and quality systems across Enterprise Vertical projects.
 



 This is a critical leadership role for someone who can
 **build quality frameworks from the ground up while ensuring their implementation across live projects** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with Project Management, Operations, Design, Procurement, vendors, contractors, and clients to establish consistent quality standards from project inception through handover.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Develop, standardize, and maintain
 **Method Statements** 
 across civil, MEP, drywall, flooring, ceilings, joinery, glazing, furniture, and finishing works.
* Build and manage a
 **version\-controlled Method Statement and Quality Documentation Library** 
 for Enterprise projects.
* Develop and implement
 **Project Quality Plans, ITPs, QC checklists, MIS, work procedures, and inspection documentation** 
 .
* Establish stage\-wise
 **quality hold points and inspection gates** 
 to ensure work progresses only after required QC approvals.
* Conduct regular site inspections to verify execution against approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Inspect and verify materials, products, and workmanship at site and ensure compliance with approved specifications and BOQs.
* Establish and manage the
 **Material Approval Process and Project Material Registers** 
 , ensuring deviations are identified and escalated.
* Develop and maintain the Enterprise Verticals
 **Quality Manual, SOPs, process flows, and quality standards** 
 .
* Identify recurring quality issues, conduct root\-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Manage
 **NCRs, defects, snag lists, and closure tracking** 
 across projects.
* Lead joint quality inspections with clients and consultants at key project milestones.
* Ensure compliance with applicable
 **building codes, inspection requirements, safety standards, and project specifications** 
 .
* Lead and allocate resources across the PMC / quality team based on project requirements.
* Conduct vendor and site\-team quality inductions and drive consistent implementation of quality standards.
* Submit regular
 **Site Quality Reports and project quality dashboards** 
 to senior leadership.
* Work closely with Operations and Project teams to resolve technical and quality issues without compromising project timelines.



  




 What We're Looking For
 * **10–15 years of experience** 
 in project quality management, PMC, QA/QC, or senior site supervision.
* Strong experience in
 **commercial interiors, large\-scale fit\-outs, or construction projects** 
 .
* Proven experience developing
 **Method Statements, ITPs, QC checklists, NCR registers, and Project Quality Plans** 
 .
* Strong technical understanding across multiple interior trades including
 **Civil, MEP, Drywall, Flooring, Ceiling, Joinery, Glazing, Furniture, and Finishes** 
 .
* Ability to read and interpret
 **architectural, structural, MEP, and technical drawings** 
 .
* Strong understanding of building codes, inspection processes, quality systems, and site execution standards.
* Experience managing vendors, contractors, PMC teams, and multiple stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, documentation, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Degree/Diploma in
 **Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management** 
 , or a related discipline.
* **PMP / NICMAR certification** 
 will be an added advantage.



  




 Key Skills
 
**QA/QC \| Project Quality Management \| Method Statements \| ITP \| NCR Management \| Quality Audits \| Material Compliance \| QC Checklists \| Hold\-Point Management \| SOP Development \| Quality Manual \| Snag Management \| Commercial Interiors \| PMC \| Vendor Quality Management** 




  




 Why Join Flipspaces?
 * Work on landmark commercial projects for leading enterprises and global brands.
* Build and influence the
 **quality framework for a rapidly scaling Enterprise business** 
 .
* Work across large, complex, multi\-trade commercial interior projects.
* Collaborate directly with senior leadership and cross\-functional teams.
* Be part of a technology\-driven, high\-performance organization transforming commercial interior execution.



  





**If you are passionate about building strong quality systems and raising execution standards across large\-scale projects, we would love to hear from you. Apply now.**

title: In-House Lawyer
description:
**Position: In\-House Lawyer – Civil \& Criminal Litigation** 



* **Experience: 6–10 Years**
* **Employment Type: Full\-Time**
* **Department: Legal**
* **Location: Andheri East, Mumbai**



  





 About the Role:
 



 We are looking for an experienced and commercially aware In\-House Lawyer with 6–10 years of experience in handling civil and criminal litigation matters. The ideal candidate should have strong litigation experience, excellent legal drafting and advisory skills, and the ability to independently manage legal matters from initiation through resolution.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for protecting the organisation’s legal interests, managing litigation and disputes, advising internal stakeholders on legal risks, and coordinating with external advocates and legal consultants where required.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities :
 



 Civil Litigation 
 



 • Independently handle and manage civil litigation matters before appropriate courts, tribunals, and authorities.
 



 • Draft, review, and settle plaints, written statements, applications, affidavits, petitions, replies, appeals, notices, and other legal pleadings.
 



 • Manage matters relating to contractual disputes, recovery proceedings, injunctions, property disputes, commercial disputes, and other civil claims.
 



 • Monitor court proceedings, case status, limitation periods, and important legal deadlines.
 



 • Brief and coordinate with external advocates and law firms whenever required.
 



 • Review litigation strategy and advise management on potential risks, costs, and outcomes. 
 



  





 Criminal Litigation :
 



 • Handle and coordinate criminal complaints, FIR\-related matters, investigations, summons, notices, bail matters, and criminal proceedings.
 



 • Liaise with police authorities, investigating officers, prosecutors, and external criminal lawyers as required. • Assist in matters involving fraud, cheating, breach of trust, misappropriation, forgery, cyber\-related offences, and other business\-related criminal issues.
 



 • Prepare complaints, replies, representations, applications, and other documents relating to criminal proceedings. Advise management on legal risks and appropriate courses of action in criminal matters. 
 



  





 Legal Advisory \& In\-House Support
 



 • Provide day\-to\-day legal advice to management and various business teams.
 



 • Identify legal risks in business operations and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
 



 • Review and draft agreements, contracts, notices, undertakings, correspondence, and other legal documents.
 



 • Ensure timely responses to legal notices, regulatory communications, and claims.
 



 • Assist business teams in resolving disputes at an early stage through negotiation, mediation, or settlement where appropriate.
 



 • Maintain and update the organisation’s litigation database and legal records.
 



 • Prepare periodic reports on ongoing litigation, financial exposure, important hearings, and potential liabilities.
 



 • Develop and maintain relationships with external advocates, law firms, consultants, and other legal professionals.
 



  





 Required Qualifications
 



 • LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognised university or institution.
 



 • 7–10 years of relevant post\-qualification experience in civil and criminal litigation.
 



 • Valid enrolment with the relevant Bar Council.
 



 • Strong experience in court litigation, legal drafting, and case management.
 



 • Experience working with a corporate legal department or law firm handling corporate/commercial disputes will be an advantage.
 



  





 Required Skills
 



 • Strong knowledge of Indian civil and criminal laws and litigation procedures.
 



 • Excellent legal research, drafting, and analytical skills.
 



 • Strong understanding of court procedures and litigation strategy.
 



 • Ability to independently manage multiple matters and meet strict deadlines.
 



 • Strong negotiation and dispute\-resolution skills.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 



 • Ability to communicate complex legal issues clearly to non\-legal stakeholders.
 



 • Strong attention to detail and confidentiality.
 



 • Ability to work effectively with senior management, business teams, external counsel, and government authorities.
 



  





 Preferred Experience Preference may be given to candidates who have experience in:
 



 • Civil and commercial litigation
 



 • Criminal complaints and proceedings
 



 • Corporate disputes
 



 • Contractual and recovery disputes
 



 • Fraud and investigation\-related matters
 



 • Regulatory and government authority proceedings
 



 • Arbitration and alternative dispute resolution
 



 • Managing external counsel and litigation budgets
 



 • In\-house legal advisory and risk management
 



  





 Key Competencies
 



 • Litigation Management
 



 • Legal Drafting
 



 • Legal Research \& Analysis
 



 • Risk Assessment
 



 • Dispute Resolution
 



 • Negotiation
 



 • Stakeholder Management
 



 • Court \& Authority Liaison
 



 • Strategic Legal Advisory
 



 • Confidentiality \& Professional Ethics

title: Associate Partner - Legal
description:
**Position Hiring for : Associate Partner \- Legal** 




 Department \- Legal
 



 Location: BKC, Mumbai
 



  





**Who are we looking for?** 




  





 Treelife is hiring an Associate Partner to own and grow the Legal practice. This is a practice\-lead role with full accountability for delivery, client relationships, P\&L, hiring, and growth. Originating work and expanding the client base is as central to the mandate as running the legal work itself.
 



  





 A commercially minded lawyer who can run a practice as a business: win work, deepen client relationships, hire and lead a team, and be fully accountable for quality and results. Strong contracting craft is assumed. Proven hunger and ability to originate and grow a book of business is essential.
 



  





**Reports to:** 
 Founder
 



  





**What will be your key responsibilities?** 




**1\. Business development and client growth** 



* Originate new Corporate Commerical work and personally drive revenue for the practice.
* Build and execute a go\-to\-market for Commercial Contracts, with a clear focus on startups and the tech industry.
* Convert relationships, referrals, and inbound interest into retainers and mandates. Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed engagement.
* Cultivate deep, long\-term relationships with founders, C\-suite, and in\-house counsel, operating as a trusted business advisor rather than transactional outside counsel.
* Expand existing accounts: deepen wallet share, lead renewals and expansions, and identify and close cross\-sell into Treelife’s other practice areas.
* Represent Treelife in the market: thought leadership, networks, events, and targeted outreach that build a visible pipeline.
* Develop a repeatable BD rhythm for the practice (pipeline, pursuits, conversion) and coach the team to contribute to growth, not only delivery.



**2\. Practice leadership** 



* Independently draft, review, redline, and negotiate mid to high complexity contracts (SaaS, MSA, SOW, amendments, change orders) and secure favourable positions for clients.
* Own the full contract lifecycle: renewals, extensions, renegotiations, amendments, terminations, and data protection compliance (GDPR, COPPA) for India and global clients.
* Act as the senior escalation point on critical contracting issues, and as strategic counsel to founders, C\-suite executives, and in\-house counsel.
* Hold quality control across every deliverable from the practice.
* Run contracting AI\-first: use AI as standard for drafting and review, and embed that operating model in the team.
* Provide occasional support on PE/VC or M\&A work where client relationships or capacity require it.



**3\. P\&L and operations** 



* Take full P\&L responsibility for the practice: revenue forecasting, budgeting, and cost management.
* Own the numbers: utilisation, realisation, billing cycles, and practice profitability.
* Drive efficiency through templates, process, legal tech, and AI tools.



**4\. Team and hiring** 



* Recruit, train, and mentor senior and junior associates. Building capacity is a core part of the role.
* Foster a culture of excellence, commercial awareness, and accountability.
* Conduct performance reviews and own career progression for the team.



  





**What are the key requirements for the role?** 



* LLB/LLM or BA (LLB/LLM) from a recognized university;
* 12 \- 15 years of Post\-Qualification Experience (PQE) at a top\-tier law firm, boutique corporate firm, or in a senior in\-house legal leadership role, with substantial hands\-on experience in:
* Commercial contracts, including SAAS, MSA, SOW and global contract lifecycle management
* Data protection and privacy compliance (GDPR, COPPA and equivalent)
* Exposure to PE/VC transactions or M\&A is a plus, though not the core focus of this role
* Proven track record independently leading a high\-volume commercial contracting practice, ideally within the startup or tech industry;
* AI\-native, using AI tools as the default first step in drafting, reviewing, and researching contracts, not as an occasional add\-on;
* Demonstrated success in business development, with experience managing client and business relationships at a senior level;
* Strong financial literacy, with prior experience managing a P\&L, team targets, and billing metrics;
* Ability to exercise judgment and discretion to opine on legal issues effectively;
* Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with a history of building and retaining strong legal teams;
* Prior startup or tech industry experience strongly preferred.

title: Legal Counsel - Mergers & Acquisitions
description:
**Role Overview :** 




  





 Legal counsel will be responsible for leading strategic M\&A transactions, drafting and negotiating complex, high\-value commercial agreements, and managing cross\-functional corporate projects. This role serves as a key legal advisor to senior leadership, balancing risk mitigation with business growth, while actively contributing to the overall development and scaling of the corporate legal function.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





**1\. M\&A \& Strategic Transactions** 



* End\-to\-end legal support for M\&A, joint ventures, strategic investments, and restructurings—from NDA execution to post\-merger integration.
* Drive transaction execution: conduct and manage legal due diligence, draft and negotiate transaction documents (term sheets, SHAs, SPAs, SSAs, asset purchase agreements), and coordinate regulatory/compliance approvals.
* Partner with Finance, Tax, Strategy, and external legal counsel to structure deals, manage transaction risks, and ensure seamless closing.



  





**2\. Complex Contracting \& Commercial Transactions** 



* Draft, vet, and negotiate high\-complexity, cross\-border, and bespoke commercial agreements (MSAs, Software/IP Licensing, Strategic Alliances, Joint Development, EPC/Infrastructure, Outsourcing, Distribution, and Vendor Agreements).
* Manage standard commercial contracts (Lease/Leave \& License, Warehousing, Marketing, Endorsement, Workplace Support, Manpower, SOWs, NDAs) with an emphasis on turnaround time and process efficiency.
* Identify legal deviations from standard positions, assess risk exposure, and present risk\-mitigation strategies to business teams.
* Lead complex, high\-stakes external contract negotiations with senior counterparties.



  





  





**3\. Corporate Projects \& Strategic Advisory** 



* Lead legal strategy for key corporate initiatives, new business launches, product rollouts, and internal reorganizations.
* Provide pragmatic, actionable legal counsel to internal stakeholders across Business, Admin, Procurement, IT, Finance, Tax, Marketing, and HR.
* Review marketing collaterals, advise on IP/branding strategies, and oversee trademark licensing and enforcement activities across regions.
* Manage real estate portfolio documentation, ensuring appropriate stamping, registration, and local compliance across India.



  





**4\. Corporate Legal Function Development \& Governance** 



* Build and standardize the legal ops infrastructure: design contract templates, playbooks, SLA workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Implement and manage digital legal tech tools (Contract Lifecycle Management / CLM platforms, compliance trackers, repository tools).
* Track regulatory changes and emerging legal risks, translating them into policy updates and internal training for business teams.
* Monitor and optimize legal spending by managing external counsel retainers, law firm engagement, and fee structures.



  





**5\. Litigation Strategy \& Risk Mitigation** 



* Formulate pre\-litigation strategies, draft legal notices, and manage responses to dispute notices to avoid litigation.
* Oversee disputes, legal notices, and arbitrations arising out of M\&A, joint ventures, or strategic commercial contracts alongside external counsel.



  





  





**Knowledge and Skill / Qualification Requirements :** 




  




* **Qualification:** 
 LL.B / LL.M from a premier law school or university in India.
* **Experience:** 
 8–12 years of Post\-Qualification Experience (PQE) at a leading law firm, top corporate house, or a blend of both.
* **Core Track Record:** 
 Proven experience in leading M\&A deals, negotiating complex contracts, and advising on multi\-stakeholder corporate projects.
* **M\&A Expertise:** 
 Strong technical expertise in corporate law, structural deal execution, deal documentation, and transaction management.
* **Complex Negotiation:** 
 Ability to stand firm on key commercial and legal positions while keeping deal momentum moving.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Ability to translate complex legal risks into business context and advise executive leaders on strategic trade\-offs.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build trust with C\-suite leadership, business partners, and external counsel.
* **Execution \& Ownership:** 
 High self\-motivation, sense of urgency, and ability to manage multiple complex mandates simultaneously under tight deadlines.
* **Process \& Technology Orientated:** 
 Track record of driving efficiency, introducing playbooks, or deploying CLM/legal tech tools.

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Contract Specialist to manage low\-to\-medium value contracts across the APAC region. The role is responsible for end\-to\-end contract lifecycle management, including renewals, vendor engagement, bidding processes, negotiations, and collaboration with cross\-functional teams such as Procurement, Legal, and Global Governance.
   

  

**Your tasks:**

* Take full ownership of existing contracts and associated catalogues within the APAC region.
* Act as the single point of contact for all contract\-related queries and vendor management activities.
* Maintain contract repository, ensure compliance, and track key contract milestones.


**Renewals \& Spend Analysis**
* Monitor upcoming contract renewals and proactively review spend patterns.
* Conduct spend analysis and consolidation to identify optimization opportunities.
* Recommend renewal, renegotiation, or termination based on business needs and cost efficiency.


**Stakeholder Coordination**
* Collaborate closely with Buyers and End Users to determine contract renewal requirements.
* Align procurement strategies with business needs and timelines.
* Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders on contract status and risks.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills to confidently address queries and explain procurement decisions with clarity


**Contract Extensions \& Creation**
* Manage contract extensions, ensuring timely execution and compliance.
* Handle ad\-hoc and new contract creation requests from initiation to execution.
* Ensure all contractual documentation is accurate and aligned with company standards.


**Governance \& Legal Coordination**
* Work closely with Global Governance and Legal teams for contract drafting, review, and execution.
* Ensure all contractual terms comply with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.


**Vendor Management**
* Serve as the primary owner for managing contracted vendors.
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to drive performance and value.
* Address vendor issues, escalations, and performance concerns.


**Sourcing \& Bidding**
* Initiate and manage bidding processes for new and renewal contracts.
* Run tenders and evaluate supplier proposals based on commercial and technical criteria.
* Ability to synthesize complex bid data into clear, concise summaries that highlight key commercial insights and risks
* Capability to structure and present a compelling bid narrative that supports effective and timely decision\-making.
* Ensure transparency and fairness in procurement processes.


**Negotiation**
* Lead negotiations on commercial terms, legal clauses, and company policies.
* Achieve cost savings while ensuring risk mitigation and compliance.


**Procurement Support**
* Support Buyers on critical sourcing initiatives and projects.
* Handle Purchase Requisition (PR) processing by running tenders and facilitating approvals.
* Ensure PRs are routed and approved in accordance with procurement policies.


**Your profile:**
* Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management (CLM).
* Strong understanding of Legal clauses and ability to negotiate.
* Experience in sourcing, bidding, and vendor negotiations.
* Knowledge of procurement processes, policies, and compliance frameworks.
* Ability to analyse spend data and identify cost optimization opportunities.
* Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination across cross\-functional teams.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple contracts simultaneously.
* Proficiency in procurement tools (Oracle, Coupa, or similar is a plus).

* 3–6 years of experience in contract management, procurement, or sourcing.

Contribute to the definition and follow\-up of remediation plan if needed.
   

  

 ▪ Manage Procedures by ensuring that Group procedures requirements are implemented locally, complemented with local specificities (regulations, tools, organizations ...). Ensure that the procedures designed by the businesses and functions are identified, updated, properly stored and communicated to the relevant stakeholders within the Operating Entity. Identify and propose calibration of procedures according to the outcome of the risk assessment and other risk events (HI, control results, external events, Audit missions).
   

  

 ▪ Implement Complex and elaborated controls and action plans: by defining and regularly updating the control plans according to the outcome of the risk assessment, regulations, other risk events (Historical Incidents, control results, external events, Audits). Perform and/or coordinate controls according to this control plan. Ensure that control results are reviewed and analysed by the Management and when relevant by operational teams / relevant stakeholders and that remediation action plans are defined if and when needed. Input in Group tools the control results and major action plans. Follow\-up the implementation of high\-complexity remediation actions.
   

  

 ▪ Document findings, recommendations and permanent control actions: Upon notification/receipt of reports, organise the follow\-up of the findings and recommendations on more complex and difficult situations, either issued internally (e.g. IG supervision) or externally (external auditors, supervisors) and ensure that they are closed within due date.
   

  

 ▪ Manage historical incidents with a higher complexity nature, by alerting the management and the independent control functions if needed on key incidents.  ▪ Provide complex and consistent Management support and governance by active contribution (or organization) to any committee on Operational risks and Permanent Control committees. Alert and escalate to the relevant level of management any operational risk incident and/or any recurring weakness. **JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence.  Lead \- Office Leasing is responsible for overseeing the leasing operations for large office spaces at large assets, ensuring effective marketing, tenant management, and lease negotiations. This role focuses on increasing occupancy rates by leading a team that conducts property tours, reviews tenant applications, and negotiates lease terms. The Lead works to match prospective tenants with suitable office spaces while ensuring the company’s goals for revenue and tenant retention are achieved.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
**2\. Commercial Structuring, Financial Modeling \& Negotiation** 
**3\. Legal \& Technical Diligence**

**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Tenant Experience**

* Strategic Deal Origination \& Anchor Tenant Acquisition

* Drive RFP management and secure high\-value marquee anchor transactions (\>100,000\+ sq. ft.).

**FatakSecure** 
 works as a cutting\-edge Insurtech platform revolutionizing how digital businesses offer insurance to their customers. We enable digital NBFCs, lending platforms, fintechs, e\-commerce, quick\-commerce, and gigeconomy/rider platforms to seamlessly embed tailored insurance products directly into their user journeys. By providing robust API integrations, state\-of\-the\-art digital dashboards, automated MIS, and seamless financial reconciliations, FatakSecure allows partners to outsource their entire insurance process and focus entirely on their core business—all while unlocking higher attachment rates and superior revenue share.
 



  





**For more information, please visit www.fataksecure.com** 




  





**Role Description** 




 Fataksecure is seeking an agile, sharp, and execution\-oriented
 **AVP – Legal, Compliance \& GRO** 
 to head our legal and regulatory ecosystem. As an insurance distribution intermediary operating under a Corporate Agent framework, regulatory integrity is core to our business.
 



  





 In this role, you will hold ultimate ownership of end\-to\-end commercial contracting, lead day\-to\-day and time\-bound IRDAI compliance, and serve as the company's officially designated Grievance Redressal Officer. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can seamlessly balance high\-level regulatory governance with deep\-dive drafting and process design.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Legal \& Contract Management** 




  




* **Strategic Agreements:** 
 Structure, draft, negotiate, and manage Corporate Agent Agreements, Group Master policy agreements, Vendor and other Partner agreement along with SLAs.



  




* **Risk Mitigation:** 
 Act as the internal legal advisor to protect the company from commercial vulnerabilities while maintaining business velocity



  





**2\. Regulatory Compliance \& IRDAI Governance** 




 Ensure absolute adherence, continuous monitoring, and timely return filings for all rules and regulations applicable to a Corporate Agent, including but not limited to:
 



  




* **Core Statutes:** 
 The Insurance Act, 1938 and the underlying Insurance Rules.



  




* **Intermediary Frameworks:** 
 IRDAI (Registration of Corporate Agents) Regulations, 2015



  





**Product \& Sales Protection:** 
 IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders’ Interests and Allied Matters of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 (PPHI Regulations, 2024\) and the 2 Master Circulars issued under it.
 



  





**Digital \& Tech Compliance:** 
 IRDAI guidelines on Insurance Self\-Network Platforms (ISNP Guidelines).
 



  





**Operational Mandates:** 
 Authorised Verifier Guidelines, ongoing compliance of corporate licensing 
 



 conditions, and Outsourcing Guidelines.
 



  





**Filing \& Reporting Architecture:** 
 Own and manage the calendar for all:
 


* One\-time compliances (license renewals, platform approvals).
* Regular/Time\-bound compliances (periodic return filings, financial disclosures, board reporting



  





**3\. Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) Function** 




  




* **Official Representation:** 
 Act as the officially registered Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) for



 Fataksecure in front of customers, insurance partners, and the IRDAI.
 



  




* **Process Design:** 
 Design, implement, and audit an institutionalized, tech\-enabled workflow for complaints management and quick resolution.



  




* **Escalation \& Resolution:** 
 Directly manage high\-tier consumer grievances, dispute reconciliations, and responses to any legal or regulatory customer notices.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* **Education:** 
 LL.B. or LL.M. preferred. A Company Secretary (CS) qualification is highly desirable but not mandatory.



  




* **Experience \-** 
 Minimum 5\-8 years’ experience. Prior experience of handling regulatory compliance within an Insurtech startup, Insurance Brokerage, Corporate Agent, or Insurance Company



  




* **Competencies**
* Hands\-on Execution: Able to draft, file, and review documentation.
* Process\-Driven: Strong capability in building checklists and compliance calendars to ensure zero



 missed timelines for recurring filings.
 



  




* **Pragmatic Problem Solver:** 
 Ability to interpret strict regulations through a modern tech lens,



 providing the business with compliant "how\-to" pathways rather than simple blockers.

**About Willis Towers Watson** 




  





 Willis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets. We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance. Together, we unlock potential.
 



  





**About the role:** 




  




* The role serves as a trusted Human Resource and Employee Relations partner, providing strategic guidance on employee relations, workforce change, policy governance, regulatory compliance and employment\-related risk considerations. The role partners closely with business leaders and key stakeholders to support organizational effectiveness while ensuring an appropriate balance of business, people and compliance outcomes.
* Responsible for compliance with country/jurisdiction law and regulations for business as usual and when supporting the integration and harmonisation for any M\&A activity
* Partner with, Centres of Expertise and Global HR Operations to support the execution of enterprise and business programs in the region/country, as defined in the HR Service catalogue



  





**Roles and Responsibilities:** 




  





**HR support:** 




  




* Overall accountability for the management of country related HR matters and support to Country Business leaders and managers in line with local legislation, regulatory requirements and global HR priorities.
* Partner directly with senior business leaders to provide strategic HR and ER guidance, balancing business objectives, colleague experience and compliance considerations.
* Educate Country Business leaders and managers to undertake their responsibilities as defined in the HR Service Catalogue and Ways of Working



  





  





**Working Work Environment, Employee Relations and Compliance:** 




  




* Independently lead and manage complex ER matters including disciplinary issues, performance management, grievances, investigations, redundancies, workforce transitions, long\-term illness cases and negotiated exits. Provide guidance to colleagues and managers to achieve balanced and sustainable outcomes.
* Work with managers to provide effective coaching on managing performance and disciplinary issues, ensuring actions meet company and legislative requirements to maintain a positive and professional work environment for all colleagues
* Lead and negotiate exit agreements and separation arrangements, partnering with Legal where specialist advice or heightened risk considerations apply.
* Lead or support organizational change initiatives, including restructuring, workforce transitions, M\&A integration and policy harmonisation activities requiring country\-specific implementation, consultation and risk assessment.
* Maintain a strong understanding of employment laws, labour regulations and HR compliance requirements to identify risks, provide practical guidance and partner effectively with Legal on complex matters.
* Ensure adherence to unique jurisdictional requirements and monitor issues for continuous improvement of employment practices and/or processes.
* Lead the ongoing review, development and harmonisation of local HR policies, procedures and governance frameworks in line with legislative, regulatory and business requirements.
* Ensure the consistent practice and implementation of ER activities through the application of uniform policies, standard Operating Procedures, procedure, governance frameworks and documented templates.
* Serve as a local resource on work/life balance issues; coordinate with managers on alternative work arrangements and lead best place to work initiatives.
* In collaboration with other teams, some participation in locally required or relevant culture, wellness, disaster response or diversity initiatives that are aligned with global HR priorities.



  





**Performance and Talent Development:** 




  




* In line with the HR Service catalogue, partner with Talent Advisory to determine specific country support requirements for the execution of Talent programs, e.g. collective/individual consultation.
* Support the execution of CoE and Global HR Operations enterprise\-wide programs where there are country specific implementation requirements, e.g. collective consultation, legal restrictions.



  





**Integrated HR Service Delivery:** 




  




* Lead ER, compliance projects, managing multiple workstreams and coordinating with HR, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRS, business leaders and global stakeholders to support successful delivery and effective risk management.
* Partner with CoEs to ensure global programs are executed in line with local legislation and consultation requirements
* Identify and implement opportunities for standardisation of work (e.g. HR process, service delivery) where appropriate.
* Utilize global HR technology, global processes and the tiered support model to support an integrated “One HR” organisation focused on the colleague and manager experience of HR services.



  





**Total Rewards:** 




  




* Provide Country specific support to the annual review cycle, specifically data validation as it relates to local policy requirements,
* Manage and oversee the administration of local benefits, including relationships with vendors and renewals, in line with market and legal requirements and in alignment with the Global Benefits strategy (where applicable)
* Partner with the Global Compensation and Benefits teams to support and provide advice relating to competitiveness of reward offerings and legislative changes impacting local programs, e.g. pay transparency, pay equity.
* Provide county specific support, as defined in the HR Service Catalogue, for internal movement of colleagues, including international transfers and relocations.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Strong hands\-on ER expertise with experience independently managing complex ER matters and investigations.
* Significant experience of partnering with senior business leaders on complex ER, workforce change and business\-critical people matters.
* Experience supporting organizational restructuring, workforce transitions, M\&A integration, policy harmonisation and other large\-scale change initiatives.
* Good understanding of employment laws, labour regulations, statutory compliance requirements and HR governance practices, with the ability to identify risks and partner effectively with Legal and Compliance teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills and experience working across business leaders, HR, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRS and global teams.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and competing deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment and balance business, people and compliance considerations when making recommendations.
* Experience operating within a complex global matrix environment and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including a good command of English.
* Ability to interact with colleagues at all levels.

title: Associate - Security Governance, Risk & Compliance
description:
**Associate, Security Governance, Risk \& Compliance** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Bengaluru, Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
*3\-5 years of relelavant exp inclusing dedicated third\-party risk management experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with more than 10,000 entrepreneurial, action\- and results\-oriented professionals across over 40 countries. A\&M takes a hands\-on approach to solving client problems and helping organizations reach their potential. Its culture values independent thinking, collaboration, and measurable impact, guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. Established in India in 2023, A\&M Global Capability Center Private Limited partners with leadership across business units and geographies to enable efficient service delivery, specialized talent, competitive pricing, faster delivery, automation, and digital and analytics capabilities. The GCC supports end\-to\-end case delivery and thought leadership rather than traditional back\-office work. It serves the Americas, EMEA, and APAC across industries including Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The rapidly growing center already has more than 500 team members.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Security GRC Associate will own execution and improvement of the Information Security third\-party risk management program. Through GRC platforms, assessment workflows, risk registers, reporting routines, and documented controls, the role will identify, evaluate, monitor, and help remediate vendor risks. The associate will complete client security questionnaires, review information security contract terms, and coordinate with Privacy, Legal, IT, procurement, and business stakeholders to produce accurate, timely responses. Success requires dedicated third\-party risk management experience, including assessing at least 100 vendors annually, managing remediation within defined SLAs, and translating technical security requirements into practical business language. The role will strengthen governance visibility, support regulatory and policy compliance, and improve the firm’s ability to make risk\-based decisions across vendor and client engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own vendor risk identification and assessment against A\&M’s risk appetite, completing assessments for at least 100 vendors annually through approved GRC platforms and documented workflows.
* Track risk treatment, remediation commitments, security performance alerts, and overdue actions, converting current evidence into accurate monthly posture reviews and management reporting.
* Manage client security questionnaires within defined SLAs, coordinating with Privacy, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver complete, consistent, and evidence\-based responses.
* Maintain and improve security assessment frameworks, questionnaires, response libraries, and supporting knowledge repositories so recurring reviews become faster, more consistent, and easier to govern.
* Evaluate information security clauses in client and vendor contracts, identifying obligations that could create exposure and aligning recommendations with security policies and compliance requirements.
* Communicate control gaps, risk ratings, and remediation strategies to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, enabling proportionate decisions based on business context and risk appetite.
* Execute recurring governance activities, including metrics gathering, internal assessments, reporting, and process improvements using automation or Artificial Intelligence to increase efficiency and control visibility.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Third\-party risk management experience with vendor security assessments, audits, remediation tracking, GRC platforms, and annual throughput of at least 100 vendor assessments.
* Working knowledge of security controls, regulatory requirements, ISO 27001, NIST, information security questionnaires, and security terms commonly included in legal contracts.
* Strong analytical, written, verbal, and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to translate technical risk into concise, business\-accessible decisions and actions.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* An industry\-recognized certification such as CRISC, CTPRP, CISSP, or CISM will strengthen your ability to evaluate control maturity and advise stakeholders.
* Experience improving third\-party risk processes through automation, Artificial Intelligence, workflow redesign, reporting enhancements, or structured knowledge management will be valuable.
* Exposure to global consulting, professional services, or multi\-region regulatory and client environments will help you navigate varied stakeholders, obligations, and delivery expectations.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You will bring 4–8 years of total relevant experience, including 3–5 years dedicated to third\-party risk management, governance, risk, compliance, or information security. Your background should demonstrate ownership of vendor security assessments and audits, with experience managing risk reviews for at least 100 vendors in a year. You will be comfortable using GRC and third\-party risk management platforms to document findings, assign treatments, monitor remediation, and produce management reporting. You can complete client security questionnaires within agreed SLAs, maintain reliable evidence and response libraries, and collaborate with Privacy, Legal, IT, procurement, and business teams. You will understand security frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST, relevant regulatory expectations, security controls, and information security contract clauses. A bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Risk Management, Business, or a related field is required. CRISC, CTPRP, CISSP, or CISM certification is advantageous. You are analytical, detail\-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize multiple deadlines without losing accuracy. Most importantly, you communicate risk clearly, apply sound judgment, and connect control decisions to business impact.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a rapidly growing India capability center that contributes to end\-to\-end global case delivery and thought leadership rather than operating as a traditional back\-office function.
* Build international exposure by supporting stakeholders and clients across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with opportunities to solve varied third\-party security and governance challenges.
* Grow in an entrepreneurial, meritocratic environment that values independent thinking, measurable impact, continuous learning, and inclusive collaboration across disciplines and geographies.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Structured performance development, professional training, and on\-the\-job learning designed to build deeper expertise in security governance, third\-party risk, compliance, and consulting delivery.
* Career growth opportunities within a global consulting firm and a rapidly expanding India capability center, supported by experienced leaders and cross\-functional collaboration.
* A workplace that prioritizes employee well\-being and provides benefits and resources supporting professional development and personal needs.
* An inclusive culture guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with meaningful work and strong team engagement.

title: Digital Cobrand Acquisitions Risk & Controls Lead - US Shift - Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on\-the\-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
   

  

 The
 **Citi Advantage Cobrand Acquisitions Risk \& Controls Lead** 
 is responsible for building, maintaining, and executing a robust control framework across Cobrand Partner channels and Partner\-Generated Campaigns. This pivotal role drives the "Operating in Control" (OIC) agenda for the Cobrand portfolio, providing comprehensive oversight of issues and escalations, coordinating internal and external exams, and managing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the Process, Risk, Control, and Monitoring (PRCM) framework—from initial design to annual assessments and ongoing monitoring. Additionally, the Lead owns the end\-to\-end authorship and maintenance of the Cobrand Desktop Manual, a critical cornerstone of OIC documentation.
   

  

 Ultimately, this individual ensures that Cobrand operates in a highly controlled environment across both existing and emerging channels and products. Proactive oversight is critical; without it, channels risk falling short of management expectations across the Cobrand partner portfolios. With aggressive partner commitments and channel growth plans slated for 2026 and beyond, this role serves as the epicenter of our control framework. Success requires cultivating deep, collaborative partnerships with key internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, including In\-Business Control, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Product/Marketing owners. A rapid onboarding and deep understanding of the Marketing Organization’s operational dynamics are essential for immediate impact.
   

  

**In this role, you’re expected to:**
* Serve as Operating in Control (OIC) Co\-Champion for Cobrand Acquisitions, establishing clear accountability and streamlined processes across key pillars: Issues Management, Exam Support/Coordination, PRCM/Control Maintenance, and Desktop Manual ownership.
* Rapidly master the marketing and acquisition business model to effectively understand, articulate, and influence critical points of intersection with the OIC agenda.
* Champion and elevate risk and control standards, ensuring their consistent, equitable application while exercising sound, long\-term risk judgment.
* Implement and execute robust risk and control practices across the Marketing \& Franchise Development organization, embedding proactive foresight, risk anticipation, and preventative control solutions.
* Deliver on Citi’s regulatory transformation commitments, driving process and control excellence to achieve frictionless execution and radical simplification.
* Cultivate proactive risk management practices across the broader team, championing a best\-in\-class risk and controls culture.
* Maintain a perpetual state of audit and exam readiness; deliver high\-quality walkthroughs and artifacts to reviewers, while prioritizing and executing against regulatory commitments, including Consent Order requirements.
* Escalate and permanently resolve identified issues in a timely manner, ensuring full compliance with organizational expectations and enterprise procedures.
* Deliver compliant, safe, and customer\-centric operational excellence through the rigorous design of business processes and the flawless execution of day\-to\-day controls.
* Proactively identify control gaps, process deficiencies, approval discrepancies, and compliance risks, driving swift escalation, remediation, and resolution with key stakeholders.
* Lead process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen controls, improve review accuracy, and minimize manual effort.
* Serve as the primary Records Retention Point of Contact (POC) for the Cobrand team, partnering with the Business Records Management Officer to maintain the Cobrand Record Inventory and execute compliance activities.
* Partner with technology teams to implement system enhancements, testing protocols, and process innovations that drive user adoption, operational effectiveness, and control consistency.
* Foster a culture of deep accountability, continuous improvement, and rigorous governance, compliance, and operational excellence within the Cobrand team.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned, supporting the evolving needs of the business.


**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**
* 8–13 years of experience in Financial Services, with a strong preference for experience in Marketing, Risk, or Control management.
* Proven track record of advanced project management, with exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously in a high\-stakes environment.
* Ability to seamlessly step into the role, pick up ongoing programs mid\-stream, and drive them to successful completion.
* Strong analytical capabilities, creative problem\-solving skills, and a deep sense of personal ownership.
* Ability to thrive under tight deadlines within a fast\-paced, highly collaborative, and matrixed environment.
* High proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint, with a proven aptitude for quickly mastering new systems, platforms, and software.
* Strong personal accountability, decisiveness, and alignment with a high\-performance work ethic culture.
* Experience managing complex partner relationships and/or external vendor engagements.
* Highly organized self\-starter capable of establishing clear goals and consistently driving measurable results.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

 CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
   

 We are a dynamic \& centralized team of talented Legal professionals. The Manager, Legal, will be part of this centralized team, assisting in legal operations for CACTUS and its overseas entities. One of the most exciting parts of this role is the opportunity to work on diverse assignments and exposure to various legal and compliance matters on a global scale making it a unique opportunity for dynamic legal professionals.
   

**Responsibilities**
* Contract Management: Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize business contracts (MSAs, vendor agreements, NDAs, lease deeds, etc.) and optimize contract processes using technology.
* Legal Advisory \& Risk Management: Provide actionable legal advice, identify risks, and develop mitigation strategies for business initiatives.
* Project Management: Independently manage legal workstreams and projects, co\-ordinate with cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive matters to timely closure.
* Compliance \& Policy: Develop and monitor corporate policies, ensure regulatory compliance across jurisdictions, and stay updated on legislative changes.
* Data Privacy: Advice on compliance with global data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, DPDPA) and standardize data handling practices.
* Intellectual Property: Manage IP protection, enforcement, and filings; draft IP\-related clauses and notices.
* Litigation: Handle legal notices, pre\-litigation matters, and coordinate with external counsel for litigation.
* Employment \& Labor Laws: Experience in employment and labour law, with the ability to advise on employment\-related matters and support HR and business stakeholders on practical legal and compliance requirements.
* Operational Excellence: Drive process improvement, standardization, and automation across legal operations, including developing SOPs, templates, workflows, trackers, and other tools to improve efficiency and consistency.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* Bachelor of Law (LLB) with work experience of 8\-10 years.
* Business Partnering, working closely with internal teams to address legal concerns and provide practical solutions that align with business objectives.
* Strong communication skills to simplify legal concepts for non\-legal teams.
* Ability to independently manage projects, priorities, stakeholders, and high volumes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and multi\-tasking skills with attention to detail.
* Fast closure and efficiency.
* Exceptional drafting, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated expertise in international corporate and contractual laws.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Highly motivated, independent, with a quality and results\-oriented mindset.


 Application Process
   

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised.Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, there will be 2\-3 rounds of interview including an in\-person meeting (for Mumbai based candidates).
   

**Equal Opportunity**
 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

**Accelerating from Anywhere**
 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
   

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


**About CACTUS**
 Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Role Overview** 




 To ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and other applicable corporate laws by managing secretarial activities, statutory compliances, Board processes, and corporate governance requirements for Essar Ports and its group entities. The role will support the Board, senior management, and business teams in maintaining high standards of governance and regulatory compliance.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Corporate Secretarial \& Governance** 



* Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, Secretarial Standards, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Assist in implementing corporate governance practices and ensuring adherence across the organization.
* Track regulatory changes and support implementation of new compliance requirements.



**Board \& Committee Management** 



* Coordinate Board, Committee, and Shareholders' Meetings.
* Prepare notices, agendas, Board papers, resolutions, and minutes.
* Maintain Board records and ensure timely closure of action items arising from meetings.



**Statutory Compliance** 



* Ensure timely filing of statutory forms, annual returns, and other regulatory submissions with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) and Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA).
* Maintain statutory registers, records, licenses, and corporate documents.
* Coordinate Secretarial Audit and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Support compliance with FEMA and RBI regulations, wherever applicable.



**Compliance Management** 



* Develop and maintain statutory compliance calendars and trackers.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of compliance requirements.
* Support internal and external audits related to secretarial and corporate governance matters.



**Corporate Transactions** 



* Support incorporation of companies, changes in capital structure, alteration of constitutional documents, and other corporate actions.
* Assist in mergers, acquisitions, restructuring, financing transactions, and due diligence from a secretarial perspective.
* Coordinate execution and maintenance of statutory approvals and documentation.



**Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Liaise with regulatory authorities, consultants, statutory auditors, secretarial auditors, banks, and legal advisors.
* Work closely with Finance, Legal, Taxation, and Business teams on corporate compliance matters.



**Documentation \& Record Management** 



* Maintain accurate statutory records and corporate documentation.
* Ensure safe custody and digitization of corporate records.
* Prepare periodic compliance reports and updates for senior management.



**Education** 



* Qualified Company Secretary (Member of ICSI) – Mandatory.
* LLB will be an added advantage.



**Experience** 



* **7\+ years of post\-qualification experience** 
 in corporate secretarial functions.
* Experience in infrastructure, ports, logistics, manufacturing, EPC, or large corporate organizations will be added advantage.
* Exposure to Board processes, statutory filings, and corporate governance practices is desirable.

description:
**About The Leela** 




  





 The story of The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts began when its founder Late Capt. CP Krishnan Nair opened The Leela Mumbai in 1986\. For over three decades, The Leela has been on a journey to delight guests by providing unparalleled luxury in captivating environs ensconced in the lap of nature, wrapped in the graciousness of Indian hospitality.
 



  





 Headquartered in Mumbai, The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts is owned by a Brookfield Asset Management\- sponsored private real estate fund and operates thirteen award\-winning properties in major cities and leisure destinations across India. These include the flagship hotel in the capital city of New Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Udaipur, Jaipur, Gurugram, East Delhi, Mumbai, Gandhinagar, Kovalam, and Ashtamudi. The brand is also delighted to announce the upcoming opening of its latest property in Hyderabad. The Leela has a strong pipeline of future projects. The brand celebrates each hotel through its unique location, art, culture, and cuisine with thoughtful services, celebratory rituals, and immersive experiences. The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts was voted the World’s Best Hotel Brand twice in a row by Travel \+ Leisure, USA, World’s Best Awards Survey, 2020 2021, 2023,2024, 2026\. An epitome of true Indian luxury hospitality, The Leela is committed to providing guests with unforgettable stays in settings that capture the essence of India. The brand has a marketing alliance with US\- based Preferred Hotels \& Resorts and is a member of the Global Hotel Alliance.
 



  





 Why join The Leela?
 



  




* **Award\-Winning Brand** 
 : Join a brand that has been recognized as one of the World’sBest Hotel Brands for two consecutive years.
* **Commitment to Excellence** 
 : Be part of a team that is dedicated to providing the highest standards of service and hospitality.
* **Innovative Environment** 
 : Be part of a team that encourages creativity and innovation, ensuring that we stay at the forefront of luxury hospitality.
* **Career Growth** 
 : Benefit from our strong pipeline of future projects and opportunities for career advancement within The Leela and our global alliances.
* **Cultural Experiences** 
 : Engage with the rich cultural tapestry of India, bringing unique and authentic experiences to our discerning guests.



  





 Position Overview
 



**Reporting to: Vice President \- Procurement** 




**Location:** 
 The Leela Corporate Office, Mumbai
 



 The Manager / Senior Manager – Procurement \& Contracts (Civil) will be responsible for managing procurement and contracting activities related to civil and interior works across project developments. This role involves leading the procurement lifecycle for construction packages, evaluating technical and commercial requirements, managing contract finalization, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and project requirements.
 



  





 The incumbent will work closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to support the successful delivery of project procurement objectives. The role requires strong expertise in contract management, commercial negotiations, technical evaluation of civil and interior packages, and a thorough understanding of construction industry practices and standards.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Procurement \& Contract Finalization** 



* Lead procurement and contract finalization activities for moderate\-value civil and interior work packages.
* Manage sourcing, bid evaluation, commercial discussions, and award recommendations for project\-related procurement requirements.
* Review technical and commercial submissions to ensure alignment with project objectives and contractual requirements.
* Support the preparation, negotiation, execution, and administration of contracts.
* Ensure procurement activities are conducted in accordance with approved processes and governance requirements.



**Technical Evaluation \& Commercial Assessment** 



* Interpret and evaluate civil and interior drawings, specifications, and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
* Assess contractor submissions from both technical and commercial perspectives.
* Validate scope requirements and ensure completeness during tendering and contracting stages.
* Assist project stakeholders in evaluating procurement options and contractor capabilities.
* Support cost optimization initiatives while maintaining quality and project standards.



**Contract Administration** 



* Monitor contractual obligations, terms, and performance throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Manage contract variations, non\-tendered (NT) items, and change management requirements.
* Support the resolution of contractual claims and disputes through effective documentation and stakeholder coordination.
* Ensure adherence to approved contract conditions and commercial commitments.
* Maintain contract records and support documentation for governance and audit requirements.



  





**Compliance \& Industry Standards** 



* Ensure procurement and contracting activities comply with applicable standards, regulations, and organizational requirements.
* Maintain awareness of safety protocols and regulatory requirements applicable to construction projects.
* Apply knowledge of NBC and BIS codes during procurement and contract evaluation activities.
* Ensure awareness and application of relevant contract laws and regulations.
* Support risk identification and mitigation throughout the procurement process.



**Market Intelligence \& Industry Awareness** 



* Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and technological developments related to civil and interior materials.
* Monitor market developments to support informed procurement decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve procurement effectiveness through industry best practices and innovation.
* Provide market insights and recommendations that support project procurement requirements.



**Stakeholder Collaboration**

**Job Description**
 About Artha Group:
   

  

 Artha Group is a distinguished player in the global investment landscape, managing over ₹2,300 crores in assets under management (AUM). Our diverse portfolio spans 130\+ startups, with 32\+ successful exits, and 10\+ renewable energy projects. As both a General Partner (GP) and a Limited Partner (LP) in various micro\-VC funds, we operate a unique self\-sustaining investment model that reinvests returns from high\-yielding renewable energy assets into high\-potential startups. With a focus on sectors such as B2B SaaS, FinTech, and space tech, we are actively expanding our global footprint, leveraging offshore structures to explore new opportunities worldwide.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Artha Group is seeking a highly detail\-oriented and experienced Associate \- Compliance to ensure compliance with all regulatory frameworks pertaining to our SEBI\-registered Alternative Investment Fund (AIF). The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and overseeing compliance procedures related to both investments made and investments taken by the fund. The role requires a strong understanding of compliance requirements specific to venture capital funds, including SEBI regulations, fund documentation, and financial disclosures.
   

  

 This individual will maintain a detailed compliance calendar, ensuring the timely submission of all necessary filings and reports, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment with legal and regulatory requirements. A Company Secretary (CS) certification is mandatory for this role.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Compliance Management for Venture Capital Fund:


 Ensure full compliance with SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) regulations governing the operations of an AIF (Alternative Investment Fund), including investment compliance.Maintain and update compliance procedures for all investment activities—both incoming (capital raised) and outgoing (investments made).Review, manage, and maintain statutory documentation related to the fund, ensuring all records are accurate and up to date.
   

  

* Compliance Calendar and Regulatory Filings:


 Develop and manage a comprehensive compliance calendar that tracks all regulatory filing deadlines (annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly).Prepare and submit all mandatory reports, including those related to fund performance, investor communication, financial reporting, and compliance disclosures.Ensure timely filing of statutory forms, SEBI filings, and other regulatory submissions as required by law.
   

  

* Internal Coordination and Audit Support:


 Collaborate with internal teams, including legal, finance, and operations, to ensure all processes align with regulatory requirements.Assist in preparing for internal and external audits by providing all necessary documentation and supporting materials.Conduct periodic internal reviews to ensure all compliance policies are properly implemented and followed by all teams.
   

  

* Compliance Reporting and Documentation:


 Provide regular updates to senior management on compliance activities and report any potential compliance risks or issues.Maintain comprehensive records of all compliance activities, including regulatory filings, approvals, and other essential documents.Ensure that all compliance policies are documented, communicated, and adhered to within the organization.
   

  

* Risk Management:


 Identify potential regulatory or compliance risks associated with investments, transactions, and fund operations, and suggest appropriate mitigating actions.Proactively monitor changes in SEBI and other regulatory frameworks that may impact the venture capital fund, and ensure timely adaptation to new regulations.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Must be a Company Secretary (CS) with experience in managing compliance for a venture capital fund or financial institution.3\-5 years of experience in compliance management, preferably within the venture capital, private equity, or investment management sectors.Strong understanding of SEBI regulations and compliance frameworks applicable to AIFs (Alternative Investment Funds).Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain a compliance calendar, ensuring the timely filing of all regulatory reports and disclosures.Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.Proficiency in compliance software and familiarity with the legal aspects of fund management.

 Total annual salary \- ₹21,00,000Fixed annual salary \- ₹18,00,000Retention bonus \- ₹3,00,000

title: Assistant Vice President - Legal Discovery Management
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title**
 eDiscovery Operations – Sr Counsel
   

  

**Description**
 Legal Discovery Management (LDM) is an internal organization within the firm's Litigation Department.
   

  

 As a Senior Counsel in Legal discovery operations team you will support and facilitate the legal discovery process, including the identification, preservation, collection, review, and production of information relevant to litigation matters, regulatory inquiries, and internal investigations.
   

  

 Duties will include but will not be limited to: performing custodial/data source research and identification, along with the preservation, collection, disposition, and/or secure delivery of data within pre\-defined Service Level Agreements; acting as liaison between LDM and its partners, participating in end\-to\-end eDiscovery projects and programs with a focus on process improvement; managing various projects with multiple stakeholders; coordinating project milestones and deliverables; working directly with all staff levels from analysts to senior management, and delivering results on both near\- and long\-term initiatives.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Act as a point\-of\-contact for legal teams, advising and coordinating discovery activities.
* Respond to and fulfill eDiscovery requests across various data sources, including but not limited to electronic communications, voice, structured and unstructured data sources.
* Coordinate the discovery lifecycle among all collaborating parties, including the firm's internal attorneys, outside counsel, vendors, and the firm's internal discovery IT group.
* Conduct early matter outreach, discovery planning, budgeting, custodian scoping, tracking, status reporting, managing to timelines and overseeing production requests.
* Coordinate with internal IT and business partners, and external vendors in support of request fulfillment, including restoration of data with appropriate chain\-of\-custody documentation, where required.
* Oversee day\-to\-day case details for certain matter types. Maintain a level of understanding of the business uses for the systems from which data is being requested and proactively address questions related to fulfilling such requests.
* Act as a liaison between the eDiscovery team and global systems and data center contacts, including but not limited to tape operations areas/data centers and third parties, to manage various legal discovery requests.
* Facilitate the flow of documents and knowledge throughout the discovery process: direct documents into the appropriate workstreams and transmit questions, answers, and information to/from the managed review vendor and internal or external counsel.
* Support the continuous improvement of eDiscovery operational processes globally, including request processing, research, preservation, collection, disposition, delivery, and control.
* Draft and/or review process management documentation, maintain organized updates and detailed matter/project notes and documentation.
* Data\-driven problem solving and decision making; manage and appropriately escalate delivery impediments, risks, issues, and changes associated with process enhancement initiatives.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Law Graduate / J.D. from an accredited law school. Attorney must be licensed to practice law and a member in good standing in the state/jurisdiction in which the position is based or otherwise in compliance with the in\-house counsel registration rules of that state/jurisdiction.
* Minimum 5\+ years of discovery experience at a financial services provider, consulting firm, discovery vendor, or top\-tier law firm, with cross\-EDRM hands\-on and advisory experience.
* Understanding of firm change management processes and procedures (SDLC, etc.) and experience working in a secure environment with sensitive data, including PII.
* Familiarity with Electronically Stored Information ESI investigation procedures, preservation, disposition, recovery, and analysis of data from a variety of electronic communication, voice, and unstructured systems (e.g., M365 Purview, MS Exchange, Connected Archive, Lotus Notes, Robocopy, OnTrack, Hard Drives, Ascent, Digital Safe, NICE, Cisco, SharePoint), backup tape infrastructure (ArcServe, TSM, TDP, NetBackup), structured data systems, databases and/or EDRM (eDiscovery Reference Model), or litigation support\-related experience.
* Project Management, ITIL, ACEDS, PMP background.
* Familiarity with, knowledge of, or understanding of legal chain\-of\-custody requirements, regulatory processes, and basic Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.
* Self\-motivated, highly flexible, organized, and team\-oriented, with the ability to track multiple workstreams and manage confidential and/or sensitive, time\-critical, and competing priorities and projects. Comfortable responding to shifting priorities and working independently with minimal supervision.
